scope: physics-informed S11 finalists; all five seeds, all five outer folds and their complete OOF trajectories
purpose: Test permutation consistency and whether frozen OOF checkpoints depend beneficially or adversely on audited graph connectivity and mechanics.

authority.reference: single FEM model implemented and solved in COMSOL
authority.identity: same case, saved time, observation node, global component and units

perturbations.mechanism: unaltered normalized node features, directed reciprocal connectivity, aligned edge mechanics, local frames, hierarchy and load-node mapping
deterministic node relabeling applied consistently to node features, both edge endpoints, hierarchy and load-node indices; edge attributes and frames stay paired with their physical edges
deterministic cyclic permutation of normalized edge attributes while connectivity remains fixed
perturbations.interpretation: tests use of edge mechanics; it is not a plausible bridge model

perturbations.mechanism: deterministic cyclic relabeling of destination endpoints only while sources and edge attributes remain fixed
perturbations.interpretation: tests dependence on correct connectivity; it is not a retrained graph-free baseline

perturbations.mechanism: set normalized edge attributes to zero, corresponding to neutralization at training-fold means rather than physical zero stiffness
perturbations.interpretation: tests information carried by property variation

perturbations.mechanism: replace local frames by identity only for routes whose forward operator consumes frames
perturbations.interpretation: not applicable to routes that do not consume frames

metrics: prediction shift relative L2 from P0
trajectory relative L2 versus FEM/COMSOL by X/Y/Z
P50, P90 and worst paired change

noncompensatory_interpretation.functional_dependence: at least one graph corruption must produce nonzero prediction shift
noncompensatory_interpretation.beneficial_use: corruption must worsen paired P90 or worst-case error without an ordinary-case improvement that reverses the paired bootstrap conclusion
noncompensatory_interpretation.harmful_or_ignored: a corruption that improves prediction, or no measurable prediction shift, cannot be reported as graph utility
noncompensatory_interpretation.causal_limit: inference corruption cannot establish superiority over a separately retrained graph-free model

historical_metric_exclusion.reason: the historical implementation zeroed temporal and load inputs together for the first active case; it did not perturb connectivity, mechanics or frames

output: F42 plus source table, caption, manifest and an audit report
final_claim_boundary: Unless both the frozen inference ablation and an already-authorized capacity-matched graph-free retraining exist, report functional graph dependence/benefit only; do not claim causal architectural superiority.
